title: YTForge / Channel Performance
description: Reads analytics_daily_metrics directly via the Postgres datasource — this data is ingested by AnalyticsCronWorkflow from the real YouTube Analytics API (or fakeprovider canned values) and lives in Postgres, not in the OTel/Prometheus metrics pipeline (see the Postgres datasource note in provisioning/datasources/datasources.yml).

targets.rawSql: SELECT adm.date AS "time", c.name AS metric, SUM(adm.views) AS views FROM analytics_daily_metrics adm JOIN videos v ON v.id = adm.video_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id JOIN channels c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE $__timeFilter(adm.date) GROUP BY adm.date, c.name ORDER BY adm.date

panels.title: Subscribers gained over time, by channel

targets.rawSql: SELECT adm.date AS "time", c.name AS metric, SUM(adm.subscribers_gained) AS subscribers_gained FROM analytics_daily_metrics adm JOIN videos v ON v.id = adm.video_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id JOIN channels c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE $__timeFilter(adm.date) GROUP BY adm.date, c.name ORDER BY adm.date

SELECT c.name AS channel, SUM(adm.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics_daily_metrics adm JOIN videos v ON v.id = adm.video_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id JOIN channels c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE $__timeFilter(adm.date) GROUP BY c.name ORDER BY revenue_usd DESC

SELECT v.title AS video, c.name AS channel, SUM(adm.views) AS views, SUM(adm.likes) AS likes, SUM(adm.revenue_usd) AS revenue_usd FROM analytics_daily_metrics adm JOIN videos v ON v.id = adm.video_id JOIN projects p ON p.id = v.project_id JOIN channels c ON c.id = p.channel_id WHERE $__timeFilter(adm.date) GROUP BY v.title, c.name ORDER BY views DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: YouTube API quota remaining, by channel
